title: Benchmark runner writes a versioned JSON report
description: As a scanner engineer, I want each benchmark run written to a versioned JSON file, so that T0/T1/T2 metrics are replayable instead of vanishing from stdout.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Feature: Versioned benchmark JSON report

  Scenario: Write report when --output is provided
    Given a materialized benchmark repository with scored eval cases
    When I run benchmark:run with --output reports/run.json
    Then reports/run.json exists
    And the file has schemaVersion, gitSha, reviewStates, aggregates, and repos

  Scenario: Stdout remains when --output is omitted
    Given a materialized benchmark repository
    When I run benchmark:run without --output
    Then metrics still print to stdout
    And no report file is required
